description: This Perl script verifies that libcurl error codes are consistent across header files and the manual page. It scans header files for error code macro definitions and the manual page for related references, reporting discrepancies.

methods.name: scanheader
methods.description: Reads a header file to find macro definitions matching curl error code patterns.

methods.name: scanmanpage
methods.description: Reads the manual page to find references to curl error code patterns.

search-terms: libcurl header and man page consistency
